mapper.sql: select o.id, o.order_no, o.binding_id, o.parent_id, o.parent_user_id, o.tutor_id, o.tutor_user_id, o.wechat_open_id, o.service_times_snapshot, o.lesson_count, o.hourly_price, o.total_amount, o.commission_rate, o.status, o.wechat_transaction_id, o.request_id, o.pay_time, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, p.name as parent_name, ui.user_name as tutor_name from tutoring_order o left join parents p on p.id = o.parent_id left join user_info ui on ui.id = o.tutor_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into tutoring_order ( id, order_no, binding_id, parent_id, parent_user_id, tutor_id, tutor_user_id, wechat_open_id, service_times_snapshot, lesson_count, hourly_price, total_amount, commission_rate, status, wechat_transaction_id, request_id, pay_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{id}, #{orderNo}, #{bindingId}, #{parentId}, #{parentUserId}, #{tutorId}, #{tutorUserId}, #{wechatOpenId}, #{serviceTimesSnapshot}, #{lessonCount}, #{hourlyPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{commissionRate}, #{status}, #{wechatTransactionId}, #{requestId}, #{payTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: where o.parent_user_id = #{parentUserId} order by o.create_time desc, o.id desc
